name: Ojer Axonil
description: The god of fury and strength who raised the Thousand Moons and defeated Aclazotz.

timeline.summary: Ojer Axonil leads a thousand champions, defeats Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes and imprisons him, ending the Whispering War.

timeline.summary: Ojer Axonil battles Aclazotz, tears out one of his eyes, and drags him back beyond the veil while his most faithful slip away from the Core.
timeline.quote: where the god of fury and strength tore out one of Aclazotz's eyes and subdued him.

timeline.summary: After the veil weakens, Aclazotz begins the Whispering War and Axonil, drawn by the battle, is the first god to emerge from the Core.
timeline.quote: Ojer Axonil was the first god to emerge.

timeline.summary: Axonil learns Aclazotz is a demon wearing his nephew's skin and warns Ojer Taq.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz was not his kin, as Axonil expected, but a demon wearing his nephew 's skin.

citation.text: "Axonil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Axonil raises a company of one thousand champions and enters the war.
timeline.quote: raising a company of one thousand champions to follow him into battle

timeline.summary: Axonil defeats Aclazotz, tears out an eye and imprisons him away from the Core.
timeline.quote: Axonil defeated Aclazotz, tearing out one of his eyes and imprisoning him away from the Core.

citation.text: "Axonil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Axonil, drawn into the Core by the Whispering War, pulls his elder sibling Taq from the veil.
timeline.quote: he reached into the veil and pulled his elder sibling to his side

timeline.summary: Aclazotz attempts to take Taq's life; Axonil rescues them, takes the Betrayer's eye and imprisons him.
timeline.quote: Axonil rescued them, taking the Betrayer's eye and imprisoning him.
